facts.text: The hotel is located on El Médano Beach in Los Cabos.
facts.excerpt: It is located at El Médano Beach, Los Cabos, 23410 Mexico.

facts.text: The resort is on one of Cabo's swimmable beaches, with views of the Arch of Cabo San Lucas.
facts.excerpt: A spectacular resort located on one of the swimmable beaches in Cabo, with unparalleled views of the iconic 'Arch'.

facts.text: The hotel is a short distance from the heart of Cabo San Lucas city centre.
facts.excerpt: Just a short distance from the heart of the city centre

facts.text: The hotel is adults only.
facts.excerpt: Name: ME Cabo – Adults Only

facts.text: Rooms and suites look out over the Sea of Cortez.
facts.excerpt: Rooms and suites with views of the Sea of Cortez

facts.text: The Beyond ME+ Suite has a terrace view of El Arco, a hydromassage tub and a rain-effect shower.
facts.excerpt: get ready to capture that unique snapshot of the famous "El Arco" from your terrace, before getting lost in a luxurious hydromassage tub or cooling off under the rain-effect shower

facts.text: One ME+ suite has two levels, each with its own terrace and bar, plus a private whirlpool, fire pit and DJ booth.
facts.excerpt: It features two levels, each with its own terrace and bar, private whirlpool, fire pit, and even a DJ booth

facts.text: The Extra ME+ Junior Suite Beach Front has its own hot tub on the balcony with sea views.
facts.excerpt: Sink into your very own hot tub on the balcony and enjoy picture-perfect sea views.

facts.text: ME+ guests get private check-in in their room, turndown service, 24/7 assistance from the Aura team and welcome drinks in Craft Open Fire Kitchen.
facts.excerpt: including private check-in in your room, complimentary C.O Bigelow toiletries, turndown service, 24/7 assistance from our Aura team and welcome drinks in Craft Open Fire Kitchen

facts.text: The KORPO spa offers Sothys treatments and CBD-tox massages with SCENS oil.
facts.excerpt: treat yourself to a personalized Sothys treatment or CBD-tox massage with SCENS oil

facts.text: KORPO has a sun terrace, massage area and hot tub experience.
facts.excerpt: KORPO also boasts a sun terrace, massage area and hot tub experience

facts.text: The gym has a terrace and space for indoor and outdoor classes.
facts.excerpt: Take your workout to another level in our modern gym, with top-of-the-range equipment, terrace and space for indoor and outdoor classes.

facts.text: Craft Open Fire Kitchen sits on the rooftop with panoramic views of the ocean and the Arch of Cabo San Lucas.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the best panoramic view of the ocean and the Arch of Cabo San Lucas while dining under the stars or watching an incredible sunset.

facts.text: Taboo Beach Club has resident DJs and live violinists.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a bohemian atmosphere courtesy of our resident DJs and live violinists.

facts.text: There are daily poolside DJ sessions.
facts.excerpt: Soak up the sun with our daily poolside DJ sessions

facts.text: On Fridays and Saturdays there is a fireworks show by the sea.
facts.excerpt: On Friday and Saturday, watch the sky light up with a dazzling fireworks show.

facts.text: Guests receive a free tour that includes a visit to El Arco.
facts.excerpt: By staying at ME Cabo you will receive a free tour including a visit to "El Arco" and much more!

facts.text: The hotel hosts immersive events such as Día de los Muertos, Spring Break and Vogue Fashion Talks.
facts.excerpt: From daily DJ sets on the beach club to immersive events like Día de los Muertos, Spring Break or Vogue Fashion Talks

facts.text: Guests can book a stay with their dog by adding the pet friendly service.
facts.excerpt: To book a stay with your dog, please go to the booking process, choose your room category, rate, and add the extra pet friendly service.

facts.text: It was the first hotel in Los Cabos named a Queer Destinations Committed Hotel.
facts.excerpt: This has been the first hotel in Los Cabos named a Queer Destinations Committed Hotel

facts.text: The resort is known for its high-energy, social atmosphere with music day and night.
facts.excerpt: this innovative resort combines stunning design, music and vibrant social spaces to keep the energy alive both day and night

facts.text: The hotel offers personalized butler service.
facts.excerpt: Personalized Butler Service

facts.text: The hotel has direct access to the beach.
facts.excerpt: Direct access to the beach

facts.text: It is a 5-star hotel.
facts.excerpt: It is a 5-star hotel.
